title: A-LEMS Sandbox Manifest
description: alems-sandbox.yaml schema. Defines a sandbox: one research unit (one paper, one study). Never contains hardware config, endpoints, or credentials.

sandbox_format_version.description: Format version. Tooling refuses unknown future versions.

sandbox_id.description: UUID generated at create time. Never changes.

name.description: Short slug used in store path derivation. Lowercase, hyphens only.

engine_version.description: Preferred engine version (semver). Launcher picks an installed engine satisfying this.

sdk_version.description: PEP 440 version specifier for alems-sdk, e.g. >=1.0.0,<2.0.0

data_root.description: Optional override for ALEMS_DATA_ROOT. Absolute path. Omit to use env var.

extensions.description: Declared sandbox-local extensions under extensions/. Loaded through conformance kit.

description.description: Human description of sandbox purpose, e.g. ISPASS 2027 energy attribution experiments.

adopted_store.description: Present only for adopted sandboxes. Absolute path to the existing store. Overrides derived store path.
